lab.dashboard.title: AI Laboratory
lab.dashboard.intro: Analyze code, research information, and prepare changes. Every step has a clear scope and requires your decision.
lab.dashboard.knowledgeDetails: Review sources and proposals to save knowledge.
lab.dashboard.codeDetails: Select a snippet, describe your task, and receive a proposal.
lab.dashboard.qualityDetails: Experimental tests, datasets, and run history.
lab.dashboard.qualityHint: Tools are in a separate advanced section.
lab.dashboard.approvalsDetails: Review the plan and compare changes before deciding.
lab.dashboard.approvalsHint: Approving a plan does not apply code changes.
lab.dashboard.howDescription: From a code snippet to a reviewable proposal — without automatic deployment.
lab.dashboard.step1: Add only an explicitly selected code snippet (optional).
lab.dashboard.step2: Describe the task and generate a plan via the local backend.
lab.dashboard.step3: Review the plan and diff, then approve or reject.
lab.dashboard.safety: AI Lab does not write files automatically. The model connection is tested during a request; an available API does not guarantee Qwen is ready.
lab.dashboard.advanced: Training, history, and workspace — experimental tools
lab.dashboard.offline: Offline Brain — knowledge base and manual ranker training
lab.planner.apiHint: Only an API response confirms model availability; this does not mean Qwen is ready.
lab.planner.workflowTitle: Three steps to a change proposal
lab.planner.workflow1: Paste or select a file, preview it, and explicitly attach it as context.
lab.planner.workflow2: Describe your goal and generate a plan; only approved context is sent.
lab.planner.workflow3: Compare the original and proposed code and decide. Nothing is applied automatically.
lab.planner.diffNeedsSource: To generate a diff, attach a code snippet and describe the task.
lab.planner.taskHint: Provide a specific goal, e.g. “Use Angular Signals and propose unit tests”.
lab.planner.privacy: Do not include passwords, .env files, or private data. Choosing a file does not share it with the model; it is sent only after approval and task submission.
lab.planner.title: Improvement proposals
lab.planner.intro: Describe the task. Local Qwen can prepare a plan for you to review, revise, or reject.
lab.planner.selectFile: Select source file (optional, up to 16 KiB)
lab.planner.electronWorkspace: Optional: read-only preview from a workspace in Electron Dev.
lab.planner.browserOnly: On the web, paste code or select an individual source file above.
lab.planner.help: How does AI Lab planning work?
lab.planner.taskPlaceholder: e.g. Add search to chat history and Vitest/Playwright tests
lab.planner.codePlaceholder: Paste only code you want to share with the model
lab.planner.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g. Add a security test; do not change the database
lab.planner.contextIntro: Select code to analyze. Only attaching the snippet and generating a plan sends it to local Qwen. Never submit passwords or secrets.
lab.planner.browserIntro: Paste a snippet or choose a file. File selection only previews its contents. Use “Attach snippet” to approve it as context.
lab.planner.diffIntro: First attach a snippet. Jarvis uses the selected code and task description. No changes are written to disk.
lab.planner.diffSafety: No changes were written or executed. Approving a plan does not apply the diff.
lab.planner.helpDetails: Describe the task, e.g. “Add chat export to PDF with tests”. Qwen prepares a plan. Approval saves its status to PostgreSQL but neither edits files nor executes commands. Only explicitly approved context is sent.
aiLab.training.pollingActive: Training in progress — status updates every 2 seconds (only while this tab is active).
aiLab.training.pollingIdle: No training in progress — automatic status polling is paused.
aiLab.training.pollingFailed: Could not refresh training progress. Another attempt will be made automatically.
lab.research.aria: Jarvis web research and knowledge memory
lab.research.title: Web research and knowledge memory
lab.research.intro: Search Wikipedia, inspect sources and approve what Jarvis should remember. Saved excerpts can provide context for Qwen chat.
lab.research.howDetails: Enter “Angular Signals”, search, open a source and explicitly approve an article. Jarvis saves a short summary in PostgreSQL and may use matching notes as context. This does not change Qwen model weights.
lab.research.offlineHint: Searching requires internet access. Approved notes can be reused offline later.
lab.learning.aria: AI Lab local learning, training and reasoning
lab.learning.intro: Local knowledge base and source-ranking training. No Ollama or external GPT model.
lab.learning.tokenLabel: Local API token (shown in the Java terminal)
lab.learning.tokenHelp: ? Where do I get the token and how do I start?
lab.learning.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token — it is never stored
lab.learning.question: Question
lab.learning.questionPlaceholder: E.g. What are Angular Signals or (2+3)*4?
lab.learning.sourceFeedbackLabel: Rate a source to train the ranking model
lab.learning.allowedDomains: Allowed sites: angular.dev, docs.oracle.com, spring.io, MDN, Wikipedia.
lab.learning.trainingRequirements: Requires at least 8 ratings, including 3 relevant and 3 irrelevant. Training is rejected unless it improves validation results.
lab.learning.rankingNotice: This trains source ranking, not the weights of a large language model.
lab.learning.tokenMissing: Paste the local token shown when starting Java.
lab.learning.documentAdded: Document added to the local knowledge base.
lab.planner.browserCodeAria: Code to inspect in the browser
lab.planner.previewTruncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown. The rest will NOT be sent.
lab.planner.activitySafety: This describes UI activity. Approving a plan does not write files.
lab.planner.activity.reading: Reading the selected snippet. Nothing is sent to Qwen yet.
lab.planner.activity.diff: Generating a diff preview — no files are written.
lab.planner.activity.generating: Generating a plan through the local API.
lab.planner.activity.deciding: Recording your decision about the proposal in the backend.
lab.planner.activity.error: The operation failed. Check the error message.
lab.planner.activity.review: The plan is waiting for your decision.
lab.planner.activity.approved: The plan has been approved for further work.
lab.planner.activity.context: Snippets are attached to the context. They will be sent only when generating a plan.
lab.planner.activity.ready: Ready for a task description. No generation is running.
lab.planner.next.wait: Wait for the current operation to finish.
lab.planner.next.retry: Correct the input or retry. Your code and task remain available.
lab.planner.next.review: Review the plan below: approve, reject or request changes.
lab.planner.next.newTask: You can describe another task. The previous plan remains in history.
lab.planner.next.generate: Select “Generate plan” to send the task and attached context.
lab.planner.next.describe: Describe a task. You may also attach up to 3 code snippets first.
lab.planner.activity.diffReady: Diff preview is ready. No files were written.
lab.planner.next.diffReady: Review the proposed changes in the diff preview.
api.error.invalidResponse: The backend returned an invalid response.
api.error.busy: The model is busy. Try again later.
api.error.unavailable: Cannot reach the backend. Check that Spring Boot is running.
api.error.authorization: API access denied. Check the local session configuration.
api.error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
api.error.timeout: The server did not respond in time. Try again.
api.error.temporary: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
api.error.general: The operation failed. Check the backend.
api.error.actionUnconfirmed: No confirmation was received. Check the history before retrying; the change may have been saved.
chat.deliveryUncertain: No delivery confirmation was received. Check conversation history before sending the message again.
lab.planner.review.title: Proposed change review
lab.planner.review.intro: This summary covers only the selected code excerpt.
lab.planner.review.copySuccess: Proposed code copied to the clipboard. No files were modified.
lab.planner.review.copyFailed: Could not copy the code. Select it manually in the preview.
lab.planner.review.noWarnings: No known indicators detected. This does not mean the code is safe.
lab.planner.review.legacy: The backend did not provide risk analysis. Only the local line comparison is available.
lab.planner.review.notVerified: The code has not been compiled or tested. Approving a plan does not write any files.
lab.planner.review.warning.LARGE_CHANGE: Large change — check whether Qwen removed required logic.
lab.planner.review.warning.PROCESS_EXECU: New process execution code detected — review carefully.
lab.planner.review.warning.DYNAMIC_CODE: New dynamic code execution was detected (e.g. eval).
lab.planner.review.warning.POSSIBLE_SECR: A possible hard-coded secret was detected.
